landing.source: nasa-mer-spirit (date); MER landing sol = Sol 1 (Mars24 notes)

scene.label: Columbia Memorial Station, early mission: Spirit beside its lander after rolling off (date and offset ILLUSTRATIVE)
scene.tauLabel: tau 0.5 ASSUMED (no sourced optical depth for this sol in the scene)

hardware.label: Spirit rover
hardware.provenance: NASA MODEL (NASA 3D Resources articulated MER model; Spirit and Opportunity were twins), solar-panel span scaled to 2.25 m (PDS). Position beside the lander ILLUSTRATIVE.

hardware.label: MER-A lander (Columbia Memorial Station)
hardware.provenance: SIMPLIFIED MODEL — no NASA model of the MER lander exists. Base, three opened petals, deflated airbags and egress aids; shapes and dimensions ILLUSTRATIVE. Placed where the lander is identified in the HiRISE orthoimage.

origin.source: HiRISE-identified lander, PSP_001513_1655 controlled orthoimage (this project, M5)
origin.registration: Lander identified by eye in the USGS controlled orthoimage PSP_001513_1655: a bright, petalled object about 3 m across, 400 m south-west of the centre of Bonneville crater (the HiRISE team's area "B", uahirise.org/PSP_001513_1655). Measured in this controlled frame; 200 m north and 148 m east of the catalogue coordinate (14.5692 S, 175.4729 E; Arvidson et al. 2004). The rover beside the lander is the early-mission scene (offset ILLUSTRATIVE); in this 2006 image Spirit itself was 3 km away at Home Plate.

terrain.dtm: USGS Astrogeology controlled HiRISE DTM DTEEC_001513_1655_001777_1650_U01 (collection mro_hirise_socet_dtms)
terrain.albedo: HiRISE orthoimage (RED band, single channel) at 0.5 m, colourised with an ILLUSTRATIVE soil ramp
terrain.horizon: same DTM, decimated to ~24 m, out to ~9 km where the DTM covers it

far.provenance: MEASURED (CTX DTM, ~20 m posts, sampled at 250 m)
far.albedo: CTX orthoimages of the same DTMs, colourised with an ILLUSTRATIVE soil ramp
